result.summary: Requires a ventilator-capable critical-care bed for acute hypoxic respiratory failure, with intubation documented through March 9. Active leukemia with prior stem-cell transplant/GVHD and profound neutropenia supports immunocompromised placement considerations; severe thrombocytopenia and tumor-lysis-associated acute kidney injury, treated with dialysis during this encounter, require close monitoring. DNR and palliative-care status are documented; no contact-isolation indication is supported.
result.contact_isolation_reason: No contact-precaution organism or explicit precaution is documented; pulmonary aspergillosis and pneumocystosis do not ordinarily require contact isolation.
